package eventually

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func lookupTitle() string { return "" }

// awaitTitle is the hand-rolled eventually idiom the suggestion matcher
// flags: a deadline comparison in the loop condition and a sleep between
// probes — exactly what ThenQuery provides as a tested assertion.
func awaitTitle(t *testing.T) {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)

	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		if got := lookupTitle(); got == "renamed" {
			return
		}

		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	}

	t.Fatalf("timed out waiting for title, last: %q", lookupTitle())
}

func TestAwait(t *testing.T) {
	awaitTitle(t)
}
